command_line:
set -eu
export MPLCONFIGDIR="$PWD/mplconfig"
export PYTHONUSERBASE="$PWD/python_user"
mkdir -p "$MPLCONFIGDIR" "$PYTHONUSERBASE"
python -m pip install --user --no-cache-dir gseapy==1.3.0 mygene==3.2.2
cat > run_deseq.R <<'RSCRIPT'
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2)
})
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
infile <- args[1]
counts_df <- read.csv(infile, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
if (ncol(counts_df) < 3) stop("Expected gene ID plus count columns")
gene_ids <- counts_df[[1]]
counts <- as.matrix(counts_df[, -1, drop=FALSE])
rownames(counts) <- gene_ids
storage.mode(counts) <- "integer"
samples <- colnames(counts)
condition <- sub("[0-9]+$", "", samples)
condition <- factor(condition, levels=c("WL", "KL"))
if (any(is.na(condition)) || length(levels(droplevels(condition))) != 2) {
  stop(paste("Could not infer exactly two conditions from sample names:", paste(samples, collapse=",")))
}
coldata <- data.frame(row.names=samples, condition=condition)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=counts, colData=coldata, design=~ condition)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast=c("condition", "KL", "WL"))
shr <- lfcShrink(dds, contrast=c("condition", "KL", "WL"), res=res, type="normal")
out <- as.data.frame(shr)
out <- cbind(geneID=rownames(out), out)
out <- out[, c("geneID", "baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "lfcSE", "stat", "pvalue", "padj")]
write.table(out, file="deseq2_shrunken_results.tsv", sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, na="")
fg <- out[!is.na(out$pvalue) & out$pvalue < 0.05 & !is.na(out$log2FoldChange) & abs(out$log2FoldChange) > 1 & !is.na(out$baseMean) & out$baseMean > 10, , drop=FALSE]
write.table(fg, file="filtered_de_genes.tsv", sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, na="")
writeLines(fg$geneID, con="filtered_ensembl_ids.txt")
RSCRIPT
Rscript run_deseq.R "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78546782/inputs/dataset_d64fbfc4-2b3c-4a71-be02-6151f5fcb6be.dat"
cat > run_enrich.py <<'PYSCRIPT'
import sys
import pandas as pd
import mygene
import gseapy as gp

fg = pd.read_csv('filtered_de_genes.tsv', sep='\t')
ids = [str(x).split('.')[0] for x in fg['geneID'].dropna().tolist()]
mg = mygene.MyGeneInfo()
records = mg.querymany(ids, scopes='ensembl.gene', fields='symbol', species='mouse', as_dataframe=False, verbose=False)
symbol_by_id = {}
for rec in records:
    q = str(rec.get('query', '')).split('.')[0]
    sym = rec.get('symbol')
    if q and sym and not rec.get('notfound') and q not in symbol_by_id:
        symbol_by_id[q] = sym
symbols = []
seen = set()
for gid in ids:
    sym = symbol_by_id.get(gid)
    if sym and sym not in seen:
        seen.add(sym)
        symbols.append(sym)
with open('filtered_mouse_symbols.txt', 'w') as handle:
    for sym in symbols:
        handle.write(sym + '\n')
if not symbols:
    raise RuntimeError('No filtered Ensembl IDs mapped to mouse symbols')
enr = gp.enrichr(gene_list=symbols, gene_sets='WikiPathways_2019_Mouse', organism='mouse', outdir=None, cutoff=1.0)
res = enr.results.copy()
if res is None or res.empty:
    raise RuntimeError('GSEApy returned no enrichment results')
# Match the Galaxy GSEApy wrapper default ranking: P-value, adjusted P-value, then combined score.
ascending = [True, True, False]
res = res.sort_values(['P-value', 'Adjusted P-value', 'Combined Score'], ascending=ascending, kind='mergesort')
res.to_csv('gseapy_enrichr_results.tsv', sep='\t', index=False)
top20 = res.head(20).copy()
top20.to_csv('top20_pathways.tsv', sep='\t', index=False)
oxidative = top20['Term'].astype(str).str.contains('oxidative', case=False, regex=False).sum()
fraction = oxidative / 20.0
with open('answer.txt', 'w') as handle:
    handle.write(f'{fraction:.1f}\n')
with open('workflow_summary.tsv', 'w') as handle:
    handle.write('metric\tvalue\n')
    handle.write(f'filtered_de_gene_rows\t{len(fg)}\n')
    handle.write(f'mapped_unique_symbols\t{len(symbols)}\n')
    handle.write(f'enrichment_terms\t{len(res)}\n')
    handle.write(f'oxidative_top20_count\t{oxidative}\n')
    handle.write(f'fraction\t{fraction:.1f}\n')
PYSCRIPT
python run_enrich.py
